conventions.currency: amounts in the account currency (USD); foreign-currency questions use the original amount the bank recorded
conventions.date_basis: purchase date when the bank gives one, else posted date
conventions.income: the income bucket only: paychecks, client payments, interest
conventions.pending: pending transactions are left out of every total; only questions that ask about pending items include them
conventions.periods: calendar months and quarters; last N months = the N full months before the current month; last N days = the N days before today; weeks run Monday to Sunday
conventions.rounding: averages, medians and percentages round half away from zero, to the cent or basis point
conventions.spending: net of refunds and reimbursements in the same category; total spending is the sum over categories
conventions.today: 2026-10-01, fixed: last month = September 2026, this year = 2026
conventions.transfers: never spending or income: card payments, moves between own accounts, money to or from own accounts outside the ledger
